summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall script downloads a platform-specific tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP URL https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz, extracts it, chmods the resulting file 0o755, and hardlinks it as the package's CLI entry point. The HTTPS request is made with rejectUnauthorized:false (TLS certificate verification disabled) and follows redirects while retaining the TLS-disabled configuration. No hash, signature, or other integrity check is performed on the downloaded bytes. The source is a raw IPv4 address rather than a publisher-controlled domain, and the URL is not pinned to a content hash, so anyone controlling that IP address or in a network position between the installer and that IP can serve arbitrary executable content that will run as the installed CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
